chunk_map.heading: How we work in this room

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Fresh sequential read of chunks 0-10: the loop, repo, session, agent, rules file, and Module 2 are named before reuse; no unresolved pronoun or forward-only referent found.
Start-here and pre-read links name their documents directly; no body sentence identifies another file only by opening/page position.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No body phrase of the form 'the X you did/saw/caught' asks the reader to resolve a prior module beat.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The module contains no guess-before-reveal or predict-before-outcome instruction.
Each of the 11 chunks has a standalone claim, instruction, menu, or named transition; none is only a wait-state fragment.
Headers match their projected content: Big Idea states the compounding thesis, Key Concepts lists the loop, and Next names Module 2 and the carried rules file.
Checked all six sub-items across all chunks: no banned Not-X/Not-Y cadence, empty triple, self-grading superlative, number retraction, abstraction stack, or empty verb leg.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No communicating use of compendium, firing, forcing function, beat, mood, or surface-as-noun appears in the body; ordinary engineering terms remain audience-readable.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Bold is limited to the mandated What You'll Learn handles and reading-list mode labels; no narrative sentence is bolded as decoration.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The module is a top-level module section and its module-level chunks are covered by the composed-deck test; `node --test scripts/slides.test.js` exited 0 with 24/24 passing.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No hand-numbered Phase/Step headers or in-body Phase K/Step K references occur; `node scripts/check-slide-numbering.js --file curriculum/trainings/agentic-engineering-101/getting-going.md` exited 0.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: `node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file curriculum/trainings/agentic-engineering-101/getting-going.md` exited 0: no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Links name their targets (lecture, exercise, supplementary, reference, or external document); no page-location wording is used. Link/navigation behavior is covered by the 24 passing slide tests.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: `node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/trainings/agentic-engineering-101/getting-going.md` exited 0: 10 slides, 0 oversized, limits 210 words / 6 bullets.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The module headings are architecture labels or student-facing claims/logistics: Big Idea, Prework, What You'll Learn, Start here, Key Concepts, Optional challenges, Pre-reads, and Next all truthfully identify their sections.
